title: Underdog shows off a 32MB speech model in new demo

claims.claim: Underdog, Woof adında yalnızca 32MB boyutunda yeni bir ses modeli geliştirdi ve bu modelle bir oyun yayınladı.

evidence.quote: One such startup, Underdog, has released a game built with its new voice model called Woof that’s only 32MB large.

claims.claim: Woof modeli 31 milyon parametreye sahip ve herkesin indirmesine açık.

evidence.quote: The model has 31 million parameters and is open for everyone to download.

claims.claim: Woof modeli internet bağlantısına ihtiyaç duymadan çoğu cihazda çalışabiliyor.

evidence.quote: All of this works within the browser through Underdog’s speech generation model, which, the company says, can run on most devices without any internet connection.

claims.claim: Underdog, haftalar önce Bark adında 167 MB boyutunda bir konuşmadan metne dönüştürme modeli piyasaya sürdü.

evidence.quote: This demo comes weeks after Underdog launched Bark, a 167 MB speech-to-text model also designed to run on edge devices for transcription and dictation.

claims.claim: Underdog'un kurucusu Sigil Wen, kullanıcıların verilerine sahip olabilmesi için cihazlarında çalışabilen AI modelleri geliştirmek istediğini belirtti.

evidence.quote: Sigil Wen, the founder of Underdog, told TechCrunch that he started building the app because, instead of using notetakers like Granola, he wanted to build his own system with AI models that can run on users’ devices and let them own their data.

claims.claim: Underdog, dizüstü bilgisayarlarda çalışabilen 27 milyar parametrelik bir model de yayınladı.

evidence.quote: In addition to the two voice models mentioned above, Underdog has also released a 27-billion-parameter model that can run on laptops, along with a waitlisted app that the company is positioning as a locally-hosted alternative to Muse and Instinct.
